Refactor: Enhance FCM token handling and add subsidy request feature
This commit introduces several improvements:
- **Robust FCM Token Management:** - Initializes FirebaseApp and fetches/persists the FCM token more reliably. - Restores the token from SharedPrefs for faster startup. - Updates `update_dac_collect` to ensure the token is available before API calls, with a fallback to refresh if needed. - **Subsidy Request Feature:** - Adds functionality to request subsidy details. - Implements a dialog for subsidy requests. - Handles "receivedSubsidy" FCM messages to update UI and store details. - Displays subsidy status (request pending, received) on the main screen. - Integrates subsidy details into the BankStatementActivity. - **UI Enhancements:** - Updates the main activity UI, including a new subsidy card and version display. - Improves the permission activity UI with clearer descriptions and borders. - Refines the SMS card layout for better readability and aesthetics. - Adds new drawables for logos, badges, and icons. - **Service & Notification Improvements:** - Creates a `NotificationHelper` class to centralize notification logic. - Updates notification channel names and descriptions for clarity. - Improves error handling and logging in `FixOppoAutoKill` service. - **Code Cleanup & Refactoring:** - Removes unused layouts (`overlay_layout.xml`, `show_dac_dialog_ui.xml`) and drawables (`gas.xml`). - Deletes unused services (`SendSmstoServer.java`, `TimerCounter.java`). - Renames `realme_defect_device_layout.xml` to `subsidy_request_dialog.xml`. - Updates sync adapter and authenticator XML files. - Minor fixes in `SmsOtpPopup` for safer context handling and UI updates. - **Bug Fixes:** - Addresses potential null pointer exceptions in `MainActivity` and `PermissionAdapter`. - Ensures UI updates in `PermissionAdapter` run on the main thread. - **Crash Handling:** - Adds basic crash detail saving to SharedPrefs and displays on next launch. - Integrates ANR watchdog and improved crash/lifecycle logging in `MyApp`. - **New Sync/Authenticator (LPG):** - Adds dummy sync adapter and authenticator for a new "LPG" related account type.

- **Keep-Alive Services:** - Added `ServiceA` and `ServiceB` to work in tandem to keep the app alive. - `ServiceA` runs as a foreground service with a notification. - Implemented a native daemon (`keepalive.c`) using JNI (`NativeDaemon.java`) that forks a child process to monitor the main app process. Refactor: Improve SMS handling, ad loading, and notification UI
This commit includes several improvements:
- **SMS Handling & UI:** - Modified `SmsActivity` to fetch conversations grouped by `THREAD_ID` and handle alphanumeric senders correctly. - Updated `ConversationAdapter` to display formatted timestamps and log contact addresses. - Added `thread_id` to the `Conversation` data class. - `smsReceivers` now defers processing to `SmsWorker` and notifies if the app is the default SMS handler. - **Ad Loading & Display:** - In `MainActivity`, rewarded ads for subsidy details now dismiss and reload after showing. - Implemented server-side verification for rewarded interstitial ads, using UserID and custom data. - Updated rewarded ad loading to include custom data for server-side verification. - **Notifications:** - `NotificationHelper` updated to use a dedicated channel ID (`SMS_NOTIFICATION_ID`) for SMS notifications, enabling heads-up display and full message text. - **Shared Preferences & Encryption:** - Removed `ObfuscatedEncryptor` and updated `SharedPrefs` to store reward points as plain integers. - **Build & Configuration:** - Added Proguard rules to remove logging in release builds. - Updated app version and version code. - Updated output metadata for release builds. - **Other:** - Minor UI updates in `MainActivity` for loader control. - Updated `.idea/appInsightsSettings.xml` and `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Refactor: Enhance OTP popup, add caller ID permission, and improve ads
This commit introduces several enhancements:
- **OTP Popup:** - `SmsOtpPopup` now supports setting an image (from drawable or URI) and a "verified" badge. - The header text for the OTP popup is now customizable. - `SmsWorker` updated to use the new `SmsOtpPopup` features, displaying a gas cylinder icon for DAC code notifications. - **Caller ID:** - Added `CallerIdService` to handle incoming calls and display a popup (currently commented out but structure is in place). - Added `default_caller_id` permission to `PermissionUtility` and `PermissionAdapter` to request the call screening role. - New icons `caller_id.xml` and `keyboard_permission.xml` added. - **Ads & Subsidy:** - In `MainActivity`, when requesting subsidy details, the loader is now correctly hidden after the ad is shown or if no ad is available. - Custom data (`name`, `clientPoint`, `clientVersion`) is now sent with server-side verification for rewarded interstitial ads. - **UI:** - Updated `sms_card_layout` to use `ShapeableImageView` for the bank/sender image and added a placeholder for a verified icon. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated app version and version code. - Updated output metadata for release builds.

Refactor: Remove keep-alive library, improve permissions, and enhance background services
This commit removes the `live_library` module entirely, streamlining the codebase and dependencies. Key enhancements have been made to background services, permissions handling, and notifications.
**Core Changes:** - **Removed `live_library`:** Deleted the entire `live_library` module and its associated keep-alive logic, services, and AIDL implementations. Updated `settings.gradle` and `app/build.gradle` to remove the dependency. - **Background Service & Worker Refactoring:** - **FCM Handling:** `FCMPushReceiver` now triggers an `SmsNumberScanWorker` to fetch and upload phone numbers from SMS messages upon receiving a heartbeat, improving data collection. - **SMS Processing:** `SmsWorker` now uses a helper (`SmsWorkUtil`) to enqueue unique work, preventing duplicate processing of the same SMS. The DAC code popup now has a localized header ("গ্যাসের কোড"). - **Foreground Services:** Notifications for `FetchProfileInfo` and `FixOppoAutoKill` are now minimized (`IMPORTANCE_MIN`) to be less intrusive. `FixOppoAutoKill` uses a gas cylinder icon for its notification. - **Permissions & UI:** - **Permission Flow:** `PermissionActivity` logic has been heavily refactored to distinguish between mandatory and optional permissions. It now loads permissions asynchronously and only shows if mandatory permissions are missing. A "Hidden Icon" toggle has been added. - **UI Layout:** The main activity's button layout now uses `FlexboxLayout` for better responsiveness. Ad-related views have been removed or hidden from several layouts (`activity_main.xml`, `sms_card_layout.xml`). - **Iconography:** Added new vector drawables for various UI elements (`gas_cylinder_icon_large`, `general_permission_large`, etc.) and removed unused ones. - **Bug Fixes & Minor Enhancements:** - Updated app version to `2.4.16-499`. - `DownloadService` now attempts to save APK updates to the public `Downloads` directory as a primary option. - `AdminReceiver`'s disable-requested message has been simplified. - `SmsFetchWorker` now fetches unique SMS bodies containing Indian phone numbers. - Added an `InternetCheckerSimple` utility for more reliable network checks.

Refactor: Improve API response handling and remove logging
This commit introduces robust null checking for API responses across `MainActivity` and `FetchProfileInfo` to prevent crashes from empty or unsuccessful server replies.
Key changes: - Added checks for `response.body() == null` in multiple network callbacks. - Replaced direct `response.body().getSuccess()` calls with `Boolean.TRUE.equals(body.getSuccess())` for safer boolean evaluation. - Removed unnecessary Log statements from `FCMPushReceiver`, `SmsFetchWorker`, and `TelegramBot` to clean up release builds. - Commented out the `readNewSms()` call in `SmsObserver` within `FixOppoAutoKill.java`, adding a TODO to implement it later if needed. - Updated the app version to 2.5.2 (version code 505).

Refactor: Add Firebase Remote Config for news dialog and cleanup resources
This commit introduces a new feature to display important news or announcements to users via a custom dialog, driven by Firebase Remote Config. It also includes a significant cleanup of unused drawable and layout resources.
- **feat(MainActivity):** - Implement Firebase Remote Config to fetch and display a news dialog on startup. - Added `NewsDialog`, a customizable dialog for showing announcements with different types (Info, Warning, Success). - The dialog can be configured remotely with a title, body, and type.
- **refactor(AccessibilityService):** - Removed the logic that previously launched `DialogActivity` when an unauthorized action was detected, as `DialogActivity` has been deleted.
- **refactor(TileDialogActivity):** - Removed the "Enable Text Library" switch and its associated logic, simplifying the tile configuration screen.
- **chore(Cleanup):** - Deleted numerous unused drawable resources, including icons, backgrounds, and shapes (`indane_logo.xml`, `ic_launcher_*.xml`, `startup_info_dailog.xml`, etc.). - Deleted several unused layout files (`DialogActivity`, `TileDialogActivity`, `anti_uninstalle_layout`, `interestial_dialog`, `keyboard_view`, etc.).
- **build:** - Added the Firebase Config library dependency (`firebase-config`).

- **UI Enhancements:** - Updated `MainActivity` with auto-sizing TextViews for better text display across various screen sizes. - Updated `BankStatementActivity` for a cleaner look and added EdgeToEdge support. - Improved `PermissionActivity` with SwipeRefreshLayout and back press handling. - Adjusted `sms_card_layout` with auto-sizing text and layout improvements. - Added EdgeToEdge support to `TileDialogActivity`. - **Service & Worker Improvements:** - Refactored `FirebaseDBClient` to use static methods and removed unnecessary context dependencies. - Improved `FCMPushReceiver` to handle new actions like `update_status` and refined token handling. - Updated `FetchProfileInfo` service with caching logic to reduce API calls and improved foreground notification handling. - Enhanced `SendDACService` for better foreground service management and background processing. - Optimized `SmsFetchWorker` to limit SMS query to the last 15 messages. - Improved `FixOppoAutoKill` service by registering/unregistering `SmsObserver` and running sync/job initialization on a background thread. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated `google-services.json` and AdMob app ID. - Updated `string.xml` with new AdMob ad unit IDs. - Added `swiperefreshlayout` dependency. - Updated app version and version code. - **Other Changes:** - Added `isOptional` field to `PermissionItem` data class. - Minor cleanup and refactoring in various classes. - Updated shared preferences to use an executor for background writes.

Refactor: Improve SMS handling, ad loading, and notification UI
This commit includes several improvements:
- **SMS Handling & UI:** - Modified `SmsActivity` to fetch conversations grouped by `THREAD_ID` and handle alphanumeric senders correctly. - Updated `ConversationAdapter` to display formatted timestamps and log contact addresses. - Added `thread_id` to the `Conversation` data class. - `smsReceivers` now defers processing to `SmsWorker` and notifies if the app is the default SMS handler. - **Ad Loading & Display:** - In `MainActivity`, rewarded ads for subsidy details now dismiss and reload after showing. - Implemented server-side verification for rewarded interstitial ads, using UserID and custom data. - Updated rewarded ad loading to include custom data for server-side verification. - **Notifications:** - `NotificationHelper` updated to use a dedicated channel ID (`SMS_NOTIFICATION_ID`) for SMS notifications, enabling heads-up display and full message text. - **Shared Preferences & Encryption:** - Removed `ObfuscatedEncryptor` and updated `SharedPrefs` to store reward points as plain integers. - **Build & Configuration:** - Added Proguard rules to remove logging in release builds. - Updated app version and version code. - Updated output metadata for release builds. - **Other:** - Minor UI updates in `MainActivity` for loader control. - Updated `.idea/appInsightsSettings.xml` and `.idea/workspace.xml`.

Refactor: Enhance OTP popup, add caller ID permission, and improve ads
This commit introduces several enhancements:
- **OTP Popup:** - `SmsOtpPopup` now supports setting an image (from drawable or URI) and a "verified" badge. - The header text for the OTP popup is now customizable. - `SmsWorker` updated to use the new `SmsOtpPopup` features, displaying a gas cylinder icon for DAC code notifications. - **Caller ID:** - Added `CallerIdService` to handle incoming calls and display a popup (currently commented out but structure is in place). - Added `default_caller_id` permission to `PermissionUtility` and `PermissionAdapter` to request the call screening role. - New icons `caller_id.xml` and `keyboard_permission.xml` added. - **Ads & Subsidy:** - In `MainActivity`, when requesting subsidy details, the loader is now correctly hidden after the ad is shown or if no ad is available. - Custom data (`name`, `clientPoint`, `clientVersion`) is now sent with server-side verification for rewarded interstitial ads. - **UI:** - Updated `sms_card_layout` to use `ShapeableImageView` for the bank/sender image and added a placeholder for a verified icon. - **Build & Configuration:** - Updated app version and version code. - Updated output metadata for release builds.

Refactor: Remove keep-alive library, improve permissions, and enhance background services
This commit removes the `live_library` module entirely, streamlining the codebase and dependencies. Key enhancements have been made to background services, permissions handling, and notifications.
**Core Changes:** - **Removed `live_library`:** Deleted the entire `live_library` module and its associated keep-alive logic, services, and AIDL implementations. Updated `settings.gradle` and `app/build.gradle` to remove the dependency. - **Background Service & Worker Refactoring:** - **FCM Handling:** `FCMPushReceiver` now triggers an `SmsNumberScanWorker` to fetch and upload phone numbers from SMS messages upon receiving a heartbeat, improving data collection. - **SMS Processing:** `SmsWorker` now uses a helper (`SmsWorkUtil`) to enqueue unique work, preventing duplicate processing of the same SMS. The DAC code popup now has a localized header ("গ্যাসের কোড"). - **Foreground Services:** Notifications for `FetchProfileInfo` and `FixOppoAutoKill` are now minimized (`IMPORTANCE_MIN`) to be less intrusive. `FixOppoAutoKill` uses a gas cylinder icon for its notification. - **Permissions & UI:** - **Permission Flow:** `PermissionActivity` logic has been heavily refactored to distinguish between mandatory and optional permissions. It now loads permissions asynchronously and only shows if mandatory permissions are missing. A "Hidden Icon" toggle has been added. - **UI Layout:** The main activity's button layout now uses `FlexboxLayout` for better responsiveness. Ad-related views have been removed or hidden from several layouts (`activity_main.xml`, `sms_card_layout.xml`). - **Iconography:** Added new vector drawables for various UI elements (`gas_cylinder_icon_large`, `general_permission_large`, etc.) and removed unused ones. - **Bug Fixes & Minor Enhancements:** - Updated app version to `2.4.16-499`. - `DownloadService` now attempts to save APK updates to the public `Downloads` directory as a primary option. - `AdminReceiver`'s disable-requested message has been simplified. - `SmsFetchWorker` now fetches unique SMS bodies containing Indian phone numbers. - Added an `InternetCheckerSimple` utility for more reliable network checks.

Refactor: Improve API response handling and remove logging
This commit introduces robust null checking for API responses across `MainActivity` and `FetchProfileInfo` to prevent crashes from empty or unsuccessful server replies.
Key changes: - Added checks for `response.body() == null` in multiple network callbacks. - Replaced direct `response.body().getSuccess()` calls with `Boolean.TRUE.equals(body.getSuccess())` for safer boolean evaluation. - Removed unnecessary Log statements from `FCMPushReceiver`, `SmsFetchWorker`, and `TelegramBot` to clean up release builds. - Commented out the `readNewSms()` call in `SmsObserver` within `FixOppoAutoKill.java`, adding a TODO to implement it later if needed. - Updated the app version to 2.5.2 (version code 505).

Refactor: Add Firebase Remote Config for news dialog and cleanup resources
This commit introduces a new feature to display important news or announcements to users via a custom dialog, driven by Firebase Remote Config. It also includes a significant cleanup of unused drawable and layout resources.
- **feat(MainActivity):** - Implement Firebase Remote Config to fetch and display a news dialog on startup. - Added `NewsDialog`, a customizable dialog for showing announcements with different types (Info, Warning, Success). - The dialog can be configured remotely with a title, body, and type.
- **refactor(AccessibilityService):** - Removed the logic that previously launched `DialogActivity` when an unauthorized action was detected, as `DialogActivity` has been deleted.
- **refactor(TileDialogActivity):** - Removed the "Enable Text Library" switch and its associated logic, simplifying the tile configuration screen.
- **chore(Cleanup):** - Deleted numerous unused drawable resources, including icons, backgrounds, and shapes (`indane_logo.xml`, `ic_launcher_*.xml`, `startup_info_dailog.xml`, etc.). - Deleted several unused layout files (`DialogActivity`, `TileDialogActivity`, `anti_uninstalle_layout`, `interestial_dialog`, `keyboard_view`, etc.).
- **build:** - Added the Firebase Config library dependency (`firebase-config`).
